LESSON: READING 5.2.1 STUDY SKILLS- REFERENCE MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the importance of reference materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 5.2.1 STUDY SKILLS- REFERENCE MATERIALS
This lesson teaches Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials above.
2. Explain Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the importance of reference materials?
2. How can one use reference materials appropriately?

SECTION: REMEMBER
